public_rationale: On February 26, 2024, Mistral announced a partnership with Microsoft to distribute its models through Azure [e6]. This establishes a new commercial AI arrangement with a startup other than OpenAI during February 15–29, 2024, meeting the contract's requirement of one qualifying partnership [e6].
limitations: The evidence identifies one qualifying partnership during the target period, not several [e6].
This was not Microsoft's first partnership with another AI startup: Xbox announced a multiyear Inworld AI partnership on November 6, 2023 [e7].
These announcements do not establish that Microsoft ended or reduced its OpenAI relationship [e6, e7].
